_readme: pm5Name: partial or full BLE advertised name, e.g. 'PM5 112233' or just '112233'.
Leave pm5Name empty to auto-assign by discovery order (unreliable — see warnings on startup).
requirePinnedNames: set true to refuse startup if any slot has an empty pm5Name.
Run PM5BleBridge.exe --list-devices to find your device names, then fill in pm5Name below.
